verses.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
verses.sm: O isi upu o le tali a Iopu ia Elifasa Ua itiiti lau mānava, ua mavae oʻu aso, ua saunia tuugamau mo aʻu.

verses.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.sm: E le o ia te au ea c ua tauemu? e le ua ou vaai pea ca i lo latou finau vale.

verses.en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
verses.sm: Ia e tuu mai sc faamaoni, ina e tuu mai ia se faamaoni ia te au i la ta finauga ma oe; o ai se ma te fetagofi o ma lima?

verses.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
verses.sm: Auā ua e punitia o latou loto ia le mafaufau; o le mea lea e te le faasilisiliina ai i latou.

verses.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.sm: O le na te faasinoina ana uo i e vetea mea, e avea mata O ana fanau.

verses.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia foi au ma upu faatusa i le nuu; ua inosia foi aʻu i o latou luma.

verses.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
verses.sm: Ua puaoa foi oʻu mata ona o le faanoanoaga, ma oʻu itu tino uma e pei o le ata ia.

verses.en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.sm: E fememeai tagata amiotonu i lenei mea, e tulai atu foi le ua lē sala i le tagata faalematau.

verses.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.sm: O le ua amiotonu e tumau pea o ia i lona ala, o ia foi ua mamā ona lima e faaopoopoina pea lona malosi.

verses.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
verses.sm: A o outou uma, ina foi mai ia, ina O mai ia; ou te le iloa lava se tagata poto ia te outou.

verses.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.sm: Ua mavae atu oʻu aso, ua faaleiuina oʻu mafaufauga, o manatu lava o loʻu loto.

verses.en: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia le po ma ao; ua latalata le malamalalama i le pouliuli.

verses.en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.sm: E moni ou te faatalitali atu i le tuugamau e fai moʻu fale; ou te fofolaina loʻu moega i le pouliuli.

verses.en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
verses.sm: Ua ou valaau i le pala, O loʻu tamā oe; o le ilo foi, O loʻu tinā ma loʻu tuafafine lea.

verses.en: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.sm: O i fea o i al nei foi loʻu faamoemoe? o loʻu faamoemoe foi, po o ai ea na te vaai i ai?

verses.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
verses.sm: E o ifo ia i faamau o le tuugamau, e mapu lava faatasi i le eleele. O le tali a
